plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official Salem College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog (current edition, catoid=34), Mathematics Major (BA) program page (poid=919). Salem College publishes major requirements but no official semester sequence for this program (its Print Degree Planner is a blank worksheet), so the plan is collected in requirements_only form as a single block. The recorded total is the exact sum of the itemized requirements at their exercised values, as disclosed below; the program page prints no hour total. The full degree requirements, including the Salem Impact core (published separately in the same catalog), are not itemized here. Per-course credits are the Hour(s) values printed on each course's own official course detail page in the same catalog; the program page itself prints no per-course credits. Prerequisites naming courses outside this plan are disclosed in these notes and are not recorded as plan prerequisites. The program lists ten required core courses and prints no hour total and no residency note; the recorded total (37) is the exact sum of the ten courses' printed Hour(s) values. Prerequisites disclosed, not recorded, because they name courses outside this plan: MATH 100 requires MATH 025 Elementary Functions and Graphs with a grade of C- or better (MATH 025's own description states it is not included in the major); MATH 107 requires one of MATH 060, MATH 070 or MATH 100; MATH 390's printed prerequisite is MATH 101 and MATH 121 or permission of instructor (the two named courses are recorded; the permission alternative is disclosed here). MATH 107's description states three lectures and a two-hour laboratory per week; no separate lab course or corequisite is printed for it.
